Place the application inside a sealed cover.
Supercribe the envelope with "Application for Panel Doctor".

Send the sealed cover by post to the Chief General Manager (Employee Services), Indian Oil Corporation Limited, Marketing Division, IndianOil Bhavan, G-9, Ali Yavar Jung Marg, Bandra (East), Mumbai - 400051.
Ensure the application reaches the specified address latest by 21.10.2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the IOCL Doctor-in-Attendance recruitment?
faq.answer: It is an engagement of medical professionals as part-time Doctor-in-Attendance on a retainership basis at IndianOil's Goregaon Colony for 2 hours per day for five or six days per week.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IOCL Doctor-in-Attendance notification?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application for IOCL Doctor-in-Attendance?
faq.answer: The application must reach the designated address latest by 21.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for IOCL Doctor-in-Attendance?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.D. (Medicine) / MS (General Surgery) / MBBS qualification with 5 years of experience as a General Practitioner. Candidates with M.D. or MS are preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the retainer fee for M.D./MS doctors at IOCL?
faq.answer: Doctors with M.D. (Medicine) or MS (General Surgery) receive a retainer fee of Rs. 1,610/- per hour, with a maximum remuneration of Rs. 83,720/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the retainer fee for MBBS doctors at IOCL?
faq.answer: Doctors with an MBBS qualification receive a retainer fee of Rs. 1,250/- per hour, with a maximum remuneration of Rs. 65,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IOCL Doctor-in-Attendance recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must send their applications in a sealed cover superscribed "Application for Panel Doctor" to the Chief General Manager (Employee Services) at the Mumbai Marketing Head Office address by post.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for IOCL Doctor-in-Attendance?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the upper age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any age limit.

faq.question: Q10. Who should I contact for further details regarding this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can write to [email protected] or contact Ms. A. Radhika, Ch. Manager (ES) on Landline 022 26447592.
